brief: Block of three-storey Italianate brick stores of 1871-72: cast-iron ground floors, arched hooded windows and bracketed cornices stepping along the street. Record: 1 photo plus 2 drawing sheets.

facade.notes: 217-229 E Main St, Madison IN (1872): three-storey Italianate and Second Empire fronts (one with a mansard and dormers), painted white and cream, with 1960s shop signs ('Rose's Hat Shoppe', a hardware, a paint store)

why.note: Second Empire mansards on 1870s commercial fronts
